title: German Apple Gougere
description: A classic German dessert featuring a low-glycemic gougere pastry filled with sweet apples.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate large bowl, cream butter and eggs until light and fluffy.
Gradually add dry ingredients to butter mixture, mixing until combined.
Transfer dough to a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe dough onto a parchment-lined baking sheet in small balls, about 1 inch apart.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown.
Allow gougere to cool completely before filling with granulated sugar, if desired.
